theorems.name: Submission.coarea_normDet_block_triangular
theorems.statement: ∀ (E₁ E₂ F₁ F₂ : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E₁] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E₁] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E₁] [NormedAddCommGroup E₂] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E₂] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E₂] [NormedAddCommGroup F₁] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F₁] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F₁] [NormedAddCommGroup F₂] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F₂] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F₂] (G : WithLp 2 (E₁ × E₂) →ₗ[ℝ] WithLp 2 (F₁ × F₂)) (G₁₁ : E₁ →ₗ[ℝ] F₁) (G₂₂ : E₂ →ₗ[ℝ] F₂), Module.finrank ℝ E₁ = Module.finrank ℝ F₁ → Module.finrank ℝ E₂ = Module.finrank ℝ F₂ → (∀ b : E₂, WithLp.fst (G (WithLp.toLp 2 (0, b))) = 0) → (∀ a : E₁, G₁₁ a = WithLp.fst (G (WithLp.toLp 2 (a, 0)))) → (∀ b : E₂, G₂₂ b = WithLp.snd (G (WithLp.toLp 2 (0, b)))) → G.normDet = G₁₁.normDet * G₂₂.normDet
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
